title: Shipping Fairways
agency: U.S. Department of Commerce, NOAA, National Ocean Service, Office of Coast Survey
publisher: NOAA Office of Coast Survey (OCS); ENCDirect NavigationChartData MarineTransportation map service
inventory_agency_column_mismatch: The HIFLD inventory row and its DataLumos DOI author list the agency as US Army Corps of Engineers, but the item's own FGDC metadata credits NOAA OCS (originator; contact Patrick Keown) and the description covers coastal zones (right whale SMAs, PSSA, ATBA) that no inland USACE IENC feature class describes. The board routing to USACE IENC (issue #310 comment, 2026-11-12) was therefore a documented routing mismatch, not an accepted substitution.

crosswalk.historical_id_and_geometry_match: Not established; DataLumos project 240646 and the crosswalk DOI returned HTTP 403 anonymously in this run, and no historical file bytes were recovered.

sample_attributes.INFORM: 50 CFR 224.105: All vessels greater than or equal to 65ft/19.8m in length must slow to speeds of 10 knots or less in seasonal management areas.

observed.release_date_unknown_reason: InPort publishes the metadata record (2015-12-04) and describes weekly maintenance; the service exposes no layer or feature edition date.
observed.endpoint_reliability: The ENCDirect service intermittently answers HTTP 500 'Could not find service' (about one request in three probed 2026-11-12, including f=pjson and returnCountOnly calls); the capture path retries bounded retryable failures and discards partial evidence before sealing.

capture_policy: Retain decoded ESRI JSON response bodies, exact HTTP wire bodies and receipts for the producer InPort lineage record, the ENCDirect service directory/service/layer metadata, independent count/ID rosters before and after extraction, and all explicit-OBJECTID pages. Candidate GeoParquet preserves declared source field types and native EPSG:4326 geometry without reprojection or repair.
completeness_policy: Check producer lineage markers, service directory/service/layer identity, all declared field names/types/aliases, CRS representations, pinned layer extent, before/after count and ID rosters, all explicit-ID pages, native attribute types, geometry structure/ordinates/validity and complete sparse OBJECTID roster. Quarantine incomplete captures and drift; retry only bounded retryable server failures.
coverage_scope: Complete observed NOAA OCS ENCDirect Shipping Lanes and Regulations layer: coastal and ocean shipping zones for U.S. waters. Not a census of all water areas and not the inland USACE IENC fairway product.

proposed_contract.native_identifier: OBJECTID integer, unchanged; the native roster is sparse and is preserved exactly, with no substitute row IDs.
proposed_contract.attributes: Preserve all 4 non-geometry source attributes (THEMELAYER, INFORM, OBJNAM plus OBJECTID) and values, including nulls; no silent drop or mapping.
proposed_contract.geometry: Polygon/MultiPolygon in EPSG:4326, all source rings and coordinates unchanged; XY-only (no Z/M observed).

archive_denial_observation.interpretation: Access denial for this anonymous research session; it does not imply the archive is unavailable.
